extracted.intended_audience: Researchers (domestic and international) seeking information on JSPS KAKENHI grant program types and eligibility
extracted.subtask_description: Identify which KAKENHI (Grants-in-Aid for Scientific Research) category best fits a proposed research project, based on purpose, scale, duration, budget, and applicant eligibility. The page lists each program's objectives, eligible applicant profile, typical funding period, and budget range.

rubrics_metrics.name: Grant-in-Aid for Specially Promoted Research
rubrics_metrics.description: Outstanding and distinctive research conducted by one or a relatively small number of researchers expected to achieve remarkably excellent research results that opens up a new scientific field.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Research period: 3 to 5 years (in a truly necessary case, period up to 7 years is acceptable). Budget: 200 million to 500 million yen per project (Only in a truly necessary case, budget exceeding 500 million yen is asked for). Type of fund: SG (Series of Single-year Grants).

rubrics_metrics.name: Grant-in-Aid for Transformative Research Areas (A)
rubrics_metrics.description: Research areas proposed through co-creative and interdisciplinary efforts of diverse researchers, aiming to create research areas that will lead to radical transformation of and change in the existing framework and/or direction of research, upgrade scientific research in Japan, nurture young researchers, and contribute through joint research and shared use of equipment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Period: 5 years. Budget: more than 50 million yen and up to 300 million yen per fiscal year per research area (In a truly necessary case, a budget exceeding 300 million yen may be requested). Type of fund: SG.

rubrics_metrics.name: Grant-in-Aid for Transformative Research Areas (B)
rubrics_metrics.description: Research areas proposed by compact groups of researchers (about 3 or 4 groups) who will be bearers of the next generation of research; aims to create research areas that will lead radical transformation and upgrade scientific research in Japan through challenging and exploratory research, expected to lead to Transformative Research Areas (A) in the future.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Period: 3 years. Budget: 50 million yen or less per fiscal year per research area. Type of fund: SG.

rubrics_metrics.name: Grant-in-Aid for Scientific Research (S)
rubrics_metrics.description: Creative/pioneering research conducted by one or a relatively small number of researchers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Period: 5 years (in principle). Budget: 50 million to 200 million yen. Type of fund: SG.

rubrics_metrics.name: Grant-in-Aid for Scientific Research (A)
rubrics_metrics.description: Creative/pioneering research conducted by one researcher or jointly by multiple researchers (category A).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Period: 3 to 5 years. Budget: 20 million to 50 million yen. Type of fund: SG.

rubrics_metrics.name: Grant-in-Aid for Scientific Research (B)
rubrics_metrics.description: Creative/pioneering research conducted by one researcher or jointly by multiple researchers (category B).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Period: 3 to 5 years. Budget: 5 million to 20 million yen. Type of fund: SG.

rubrics_metrics.name: Grant-in-Aid for Scientific Research (C)
rubrics_metrics.description: Creative/pioneering research conducted by one researcher or jointly by multiple researchers (category C).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Period: 3 to 5 years. Budget: 5 million yen or less. Type of fund: MF (Multi-year Fund).

rubrics_metrics.name: Grant-in-Aid for Challenging Research — Pioneering
rubrics_metrics.description: Research conducted by a single or multiple researchers that aims at radically transforming the existing research framework and/or changing the research direction and has a potential of rapid development (Pioneering).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Period: 3 to 6 years. Budget: 5 million to 20 million yen. Type of fund: MF.

rubrics_metrics.name: Grant-in-Aid for Challenging Research — Exploratory
rubrics_metrics.description: Research proposals that are highly exploratory and/or are in their budding stages (Exploratory).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Period: 2 to 3 years. Budget: 5 million yen or less. Type of fund: MF.

rubrics_metrics.name: Grant-in-Aid for Early-Career Scientists
rubrics_metrics.description: Research conducted by an individual researcher who is less than 8 years after Ph.D. acquisition.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Period: 2 to 5 years. Budget: 5 million yen per project. Note: Individuals who are in prospect of acquiring Ph.D. are also eligible; when counting years after Ph.D. acquisition, periods of maternity leave and childcare leave can be excluded. Type of fund: MF.

rubrics_metrics.name: Grant-in-Aid for Research Activity Start-up
rubrics_metrics.description: Research conducted by a single researcher who has been newly hired by a research institution, or who has returned from childcare leave, etc., or from the nursing of his/her preschool child(ren).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Period: 1 to 2 years. Budget: 3 million yen or less (1.5 million yen or less if the research period is 1 year). Type of fund: MF.

rubrics_metrics.name: Grant-in-Aid for Encouragement of Scientists
rubrics_metrics.description: Research conducted by an individual who is ineligible for application for other KAKENHI categories (e.g., individuals who belong to educational or research institutions, private companies, etc., and engage in research to contribute to the promotion of science).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Period: 1 year. Budget: 100 thousand to 1 million yen. Type of fund: SG.

rubrics_metrics.name: Grant-in-Aid for Special Purposes
rubrics_metrics.description: Research projects of pressing urgency and importance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: No specific duration or budget listed on this page; categorized as MF. Intended for urgent/important projects that fall outside standard categories.

rubrics_metrics.name: Grant-in-Aid for Publication of Scientific Research Results (umbrella)
rubrics_metrics.description: Support for publication and/or international dissemination of research achievements of high academic value executed by academic associations and other organizations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Type of fund: SG. Subtypes include Enhancement of International Dissemination of Information, Scientific Literature, and Databases (see separate entries).

rubrics_metrics.name: Enhancement of International Dissemination of Information (publication subsidy)
rubrics_metrics.description: Subsidy for efforts by academic societies and other scholarly organizations to strengthen international dissemination of academic information for the purpose of international academic exchange.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Type of fund: SG.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scientific Literature (publication subsidy)
rubrics_metrics.description: Subsidy for academic publication of research results (books) authored by an individual or a group of researchers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Type of fund: SG.

rubrics_metrics.name: Databases (publication subsidy)
rubrics_metrics.description: Subsidy for creation and operation of a database open to public use, by an individual or a group of researchers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Type of fund: SG.

rubrics_metrics.name: Grant-in-Aid for JSPS Fellows
rubrics_metrics.description: Funding for research conducted by JSPS Fellows (including Foreign JSPS Fellows). Includes Cross-border Postdoctoral Fellowship (CPD).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Funding period up to 3 years for JSPS Fellows; for CPD up to 5 years. Type of fund: SG/MF.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fund for the Promotion of Joint International Research — International Leading Research
rubrics_metrics.description: Grant to enable research groups led by top-level researchers in Japan to play a central role in international networks, achieve research results of high international scientific value, and foster researchers who can play leading international roles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Period: 7 years (extendable up to 10 years). Budget: up to 500 million yen. Type of fund: MF.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fund for the Promotion of Joint International Research — Fostering Joint International Research
rubrics_metrics.description: Support for joint international research project conducted by a KAKENHI grantee in collaboration with researcher(s) at a foreign university or research institution for 6 to 12 months; aims to advance root research projects and foster independent internationally competitive researchers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Budget: up to 12 million yen. Type of fund: MF.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fund for the Promotion of Joint International Research — International Collaborative Research
rubrics_metrics.description: Support of joint international research project conducted by multiple domestic researchers and a researcher who belongs to an overseas research institution; aims to develop scientific research, build infrastructure for joint international research, and foster internationally competitive researchers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Period: 3 to 6 years. Budget: up to 20 million yen. Type of fund: MF.

rubrics_metrics.name: Home-Returning Researcher Development Research
rubrics_metrics.description: Support of research to be conducted by a Japanese researcher with current affiliation abroad who is to be newly appointed at a university or research institution in Japan.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Period: up to 3 years. Budget: up to 50 million yen. Type of fund: MF.

rubrics_metrics.name: Type of fund codes: SG and MF
rubrics_metrics.description: Classification of grant administrative/funding style used across KAKENHI categories.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: SG = Series of Single-year Grants. MF = Multi-year Fund.
